kaps_punt: Basiese noodhulp in verskillende situasies: snye en skaafplekke, brandwonde, skroeiwonde en sonbrand, insekbyte en -steke, kneusings, vergiftiging, bloeding, verstikking.

items.bewering: Noodhulp is die eerste hulp totdat beter hulp daar is.
items.bron: IFRC First Aid Policy (ifrc.org/sites/default/files/2022-09/IFRC-First%20Aid-Policy-EN.pdf): first aid is 'immediate help provided to a sick or injured person until professional help arrives'. 'Eerste' here means the first help given, not a record claim.

items.bewering: Dit vervang nie die kliniek nie.
items.bron: IFRC First Aid Policy (help until professional help arrives); NHS Cuts and grazes (nhs.uk/conditions/cuts-and-grazes) lists when medical help is needed.

items.bewering: Kyk eers of dit vir jou veilig is. Raak nooit aan iemand wat aan elektrisiteit vas is nie.
items.bron: St John Ambulance UK, Electrocution (sja.org.uk/first-aid-advice/electrocution): 'Do not touch the casualty if they're still in contact with the electrical source as you are at risk of electrocution'; turn off the source first.

items.bewering: Roep 'n grootmens en begin terselfdertyd met wat nie kan wag nie, soos koel water op 'n brandwond of druk op bloeding.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds (nhs.uk/conditions/burns-and-scalds): cool 'as soon as possible'; British Red Cross, Bleeding heavily (redcross.org.uk): apply pressure and ask someone else to call if you cannot.

items.bewering: Hardloop of stuur iemand na die naaste grootmens as niemand naby is nie. Los die mens nie langer alleen as nodig nie.
items.bron: British Red Cross, Bleeding heavily and Poisoning (redcross.org.uk): get help or have someone else call, keep checking on the person while waiting. 'Naaste' is practical advice, not a record claim.

items.bewering: Raak nie met kaal hande aan 'n ander se bloed nie. Gebruik handskoene of 'n plastieksak, of laat die mens self druk.
items.bron: British Red Cross, Bleeding heavily (redcross.org.uk/first-aid/learn-first-aid/bleeding-heavily): 'you can use a plastic bag or plastic gloves as a barrier'; the casualty can press on the wound with their own hand.

items.bewering: Druk eers hard met 'n skoon lap as 'n wond bloei en hou aan druk tot dit ophou bloei.
items.bron: ER24 (South Africa), Treat bleeding (er24.co.za/en/infohub/awareness/treat-bleeding.html): firm, direct pressure with a clean cloth; British Red Cross, Bleeding heavily.

items.bewering: Moenie die lap oplig as die bloed deurkom nie, maar sit nog een bo-op.
items.bron: ER24 (South Africa): 'If blood soaks through the material, add more layers and apply more pressure, without removing the original dressing.' Same in St John WA severe bleeding fact sheet and Mayo Clinic severe bleeding. Note for a person: the British Red Cross (UK) instead says to remove and replace the soaked item; the lesson follows the South African (ER24), Australian and US guidance, and both versions keep firm pressure on.

items.bewering: Trek niks uit wat vassteek nie, maar druk rondom dit.
items.bron: ER24: 'Never try to remove an embedded object'; British Red Cross, Bleeding heavily: 'Do not remove it' and press around the object.

items.bewering: Spoel 'n klein sny of skaafplek eers daarna met skoon lopende water en bedek dit met 'n skoon pleister of verband.
items.bron: NHS Cuts and grazes (nhs.uk/conditions/cuts-and-grazes): stop the bleeding, clean the wound with tap or bottled water, then cover with a plaster or dressing, in that order.

items.bewering: Gaan saam met die grootmens kliniek toe as 'n wond diep is, wyd oopstaan of vuil in het wat nie uitspoel nie.
items.bron: NHS Cuts and grazes: get medical help if the wound is very large or deep, or 'still dirty after cleaning it'. Sending a gaping wound to a clinic is standard and cannot mislead.

items.bewering: Baie bloed is 'n nood: moenie spoel nie en hou aan druk terwyl die grootmens dadelik vir hulp bel.
items.bron: British Red Cross, Bleeding heavily: call 999 as soon as possible and keep pressure on until help arrives; NHS Cuts and grazes: bleeding you cannot stop needs emergency care. Pressure comes before cleaning in every source.

items.bewering: Hou 'n brandwond dadelik twintig minute onder koel lopende water, nie yskoud nie en sonder ys.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: 'Hold the burn or scald under cool running water for 20 minutes'; NHS 111 Wales Burns and scalds: 'Never use ice, iced water'.

items.bewering: 'n Skroeiwond is 'n brandwond van warm water, stoom of 'n ander warm vloeistof en kry dieselfde behandeling.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: 'Scalds are caused by hot liquids or steam', and the page gives one treatment for burns and scalds. 'Skroeiwonde' is the CAPS term (KABV Lewensvaardighede Gr 4-6, p. 28).

items.bewering: Haal ringe, armbande en klere naby die brandwond gou af, ook klere wat met warm vloeistof deurweek is. Los net wat aan die vel vassit.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: remove clothing and jewellery near the area, but 'do not remove anything that is stuck'; NHS 111 Wales Burns and scalds (same).

items.bewering: Koel net die brandwond en hou die res van die liggaam warm, veral by 'n klein kind.
items.bron: NHS 111 Wales Burns and scalds: keep the person warm with a blanket, not on the injured area, to prevent hypothermia; NHS sunburn guidance: take care a baby or young child does not get too cold.

items.bewering: Smeer niks daarop nie, ook nie botter, olie of tandepasta nie.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: 'do not put any creams, oils or butter on burns or scalds'. Toothpaste falls under that general rule.

items.bewering: Moenie blase oopdruk nie en bedek die brandwond los met iets skoons.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: 'do not burst any blisters'; lay cling film over it, 'Do not wrap'. Gateshead NHS: cling film or a clean non-fluffy dressing.

items.bewering: Met 'n ernstige brandwond neem die grootmens die mens kliniek of hospitaal toe of bel vir hulp.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: for serious burns, call 999 or go to A&E, and have someone else drive.

items.bewering: 'n Groot of diep brandwond
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: emergency help if the burn 'is very large or deep'.

items.bewering: 'n Brandwond op die gesig of die hande
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds lists the face; Mayo Clinic Burns first aid (minor burns on the hands may need medical care) and the American Burn Association advice via Mississippi Burn Center (umc.edu) list the hands.

items.bewering: 'n Brandwond op 'n klein kind
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: call 111 for a child under 5; Mayo Clinic Burns first aid: babies may need emergency care even for minor burns.

items.bewering: Elke brandwond van elektrisiteit of 'n chemikalie
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: emergency help if it 'has been caused by an acid or chemical, or by electricity'; Mayo Clinic: emergency care for burns from electricity or strong chemicals.

items.bewering: Kom uit die son in die skaduwee. Koel die vel met koel water of 'n nat lap en drink water.
items.bron: NHS 111 Wales Sunburn (111.wales.nhs.uk/Sunburn): get out of the sun, cool the skin with a cool shower, bath or damp towel, drink plenty of water.

items.bewering: By blase oor 'n groot stuk vel, koors of naarheid het jy 'n grootmens en die kliniek nodig.
items.bron: NHS sunburn guidance (via NHS 111 Wales): get help for blistering or swelling, a temperature of 38C or above, or feeling sick; also if it covers a large area.

items.bewering: Mense met 'n donker vel kan ook sonbrand kry.
items.bron: MD Anderson Cancer Center, 'Can dark-skinned people get a sunburn?' (mdanderson.org): yes; melanin gives partial protection only.

items.bewering: Keer dit met 'n hoed en klere wat die vel bedek. Sonskerm en skaduwee in die middel van die dag help ook.
items.bron: Public Health Wales Sun safety (phw.nhs.wales/knowledge-article/sun-safety) and NHS Lincolnshire ICB: wide-brimmed hat, covering clothing, SPF 30+ sunscreen, shade when the sun is strongest (11am-3pm).

items.bewering: Gaan eers weg van die insekte.
items.bron: Wikipedia, Bee sting (alarm pheromones from a sting draw other bees); Pace University first aid guide: move away from the hive for that reason.

items.bewering: Haal 'n by se angel so gou moontlik uit.
items.bron: NHS Insect bites and stings (nhs.uk/conditions/insect-bites-and-stings): if the stinger is in the skin, 'the first thing you need to do is remove it carefully'.

items.bewering: Was die plek met seep en water en hou 'n koue lap daarop, maar moenie krap nie.
items.bron: NHS Insect bites and stings: wash with soap and water; a cloth soaked in cold water or a wrapped ice pack; 'do not scratch'.

items.bewering: Die gevaartekens is die belangrikste.
items.bron: NHS Insect bites and stings: these signs need a 999 call, while ordinary bites are treated at home, so ranking them first is sound.

items.bewering: Kyk of iemand sukkel om asem te haal of duiselig raak. Kyk ook of sy gesig, lippe of tong swel.
items.bron: NHS Insect bites and stings, call 999 if: lips, mouth, throat or tongue suddenly swell; struggling to breathe; suddenly dizzy.

items.bewering: 'n Steek in die mond of keel is ook gevaarlik. Die swelling kan die keel toedruk.
items.bron: NHS Insect bites and stings: urgent help if 'stung in your mouth or throat'; 999 if the throat feels tight or swallowing is hard.

items.bewering: By enige hiervan roep jy dadelik 'n grootmens wat vir hulp bel.
items.bron: NHS Insect bites and stings: these signs need an immediate 999 call.

items.bewering: 'n Kneusing is bloed wat na 'n stamp onder die vel uitgeloop het.
items.bron: MedlinePlus, Bruise (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007213.htm): small blood vessels break and leak into the tissue beneath the skin.

items.bewering: Hou 'n koue lap, of ys wat in 'n lap toegedraai is, 'n rukkie daarop. Sit nooit ys direk op die vel nie. Laat die deel rus.
items.bron: Royal Berkshire NHS Trust RICE leaflet: 'Do not apply ice directly to skin', wrap it in a towel, 10-20 minutes, rest; MedlinePlus, Bruise (same).

items.bewering: Dit kan 'n gebreekte been wees as die deel baie seer is, swel of nie wil beweeg nie. Gaan dan saam met 'n grootmens kliniek toe.
items.bron: Mayo Clinic, Fractures first aid: get help for pain that persists with gentle pressure or movement, deformity, swelling.

items.bewering: Vertel altyd 'n grootmens van 'n stamp teen die kop.
items.bron: NHS 111 Wales, Head injury and concussion: watch a child after a head injury, because warning signs (vomiting, drowsiness, headache) can appear later and need A&E. An adult has to know in order to watch.

items.bewering: Roep dadelik 'n grootmens en wys die houer as iemand iets giftigs gesluk het.
items.bron: NHS Poisoning (nhs.uk/conditions/poisoning): get medical help straight away; look for packaging or containers and bring them.

items.bewering: Dit geld ook vir medisyne wat nie syne is nie en vir te veel van sy eie medisyne.
items.bron: NHS Poisoning lists medicines such as paracetamol and ibuprofen as causes; an overdose of one's own medicine is poisoning by the same mechanism.

items.bewering: Moenie die mens laat opgooi nie.
items.bron: NHS Poisoning: 'do not try to make someone sick'; British Red Cross, Poisoning: 'Do not make the person sick' (can damage the throat or block the airway).

items.bewering: Gee niks te eet of drink nie, tensy die kliniek of 'n hulplyn so se. Die grootmens bel vir hulp.
items.bron: NSW Poisons Information Centre: 'DO NOT eat or drink until you have spoken to the Poisons Information Centre'; NHS Poisoning: do not offer anything to eat or drink. South Africa has a 24-hour Poisons Information Helpline (0861 555 777, su.ac.za).

items.bewering: Laat iemand wat verstik, hoes as hy nog kan hoes of praat, en bly by hom.
items.bron: Better Health Channel Victoria, Choking (betterhealth.vic.gov.au): 'Encourage them to breathe and cough'; stay with the person and watch.

items.bewering: Dit is 'n nood as hy nie kan asemhaal, praat of hoes nie. Hy gryp dikwels na sy keel.
items.bron: Mayo Clinic, Choking first aid (via Mayo Clinic Care Network): 'The universal sign for choking is hands clutched to the throat'; also inability to talk or breathe.

items.bewering: Skree dadelik vir 'n grootmens of hardloop na die naaste een as niemand kom nie.
items.bron: Better Health Channel Victoria and Mayo Clinic: severe choking needs emergency help at once. 'Naaste' is practical advice, not a record claim.

items.bewering: Moenie water gee nie en moenie blindelings met jou vingers in sy mond soek nie.
items.bron: Better Health Channel Victoria: 'Do not blindly sweep the cavity with a finger'; Mayo Clinic: never finger sweep if you cannot see the object. Beijing Municipal Health Commission (wjw.beijing.gov.cn), first-aid misunderstandings: do not give a choking person water.

items.bewering: 'n Noodhulpkursus leer jou hoe om te help.
items.bron: Mayo Clinic: back blows and abdominal thrusts are taught techniques (citing the American Red Cross); IFRC first aid page: first aid is taught to members of the public.

items.bewering: noodhulp: Die eerste hulp wat jy gee totdat beter hulp daar is.
items.bron: IFRC First Aid Policy: immediate help until professional help arrives.

items.bewering: brandwond: Skade aan die vel deur hitte, vuur, die son, elektrisiteit of 'n chemikalie.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: burns from dry heat such as fire, and from electricity or chemicals; sunburn is a burn (NHS sunburn guidance). The list does not claim to be complete.

items.bewering: skroeiwond: 'n Brandwond van warm water, stoom of 'n ander warm vloeistof.
items.bron: NHS Burns and scalds: 'Scalds are caused by hot liquids or steam'; CAPS term (KABV p. 28).

items.bewering: kneusing: Bloed wat na 'n stamp onder die vel uitgeloop het.
items.bron: MedlinePlus, Bruise.

items.bewering: verstikking: Wanneer iets in die keel vassteek en asemhaal moeilik maak of keer.
items.bron: Better Health Channel Victoria and Mayo Clinic: choking is a blockage of the airway, partial (coughing possible) or complete (no breathing). This matches CAPS's use of 'verstikking' (KABV p. 28).

items.bewering: angel: Die skerp deel waarmee 'n by of 'n ander insek steek.
items.bron: Wikipedia, Bee sting: the stinger is the sharp organ through which bees and other stinging insects inject venom.

items.bewering: kliniek: 'n Plek in die gemeenskap waar mense gesondheidsorg kry, of hulle siek is of gesond.
items.bron: GCIS SA Yearbook health chapter (gcis.gov.za): public primary health care clinics provide immunisation, screening of children, maternity care, family planning and health promotion, which are care for healthy people too.

opsomming: All 54 claims are confirmed against first-aid authorities (NHS, British Red Cross, ER24, Mayo Clinic, St John, IFRC). The lesson contains no analogies. The one point a person may want to know: on blood soaking through, the lesson's 'add a cloth on top' follows South African (ER24), Australian and US guidance, while the British Red Cross says to replace the soaked cloth instead.
